statement: Admin and warden can allocate an available room to a student.
Allocation input is validated (required fields, existing student and room, ISO dates within 2000-2100, end date not before start) with clear messages.
A student has at most one active allocation; cancelled history does not block a new allocation.
Room capacity is never exceeded; full and maintenance rooms refuse allocation; room status follows occupancy.
An active allocation can be moved to another room with a free bed; counters move consistently; invalid moves change nothing.
An active allocation can be cancelled after confirmation; the bed is freed; a cancelled allocation cannot be cancelled or reallocated again.
Admin and warden can list, search, filter (block, status) and paginate allocations.
Available rooms are listed for admin, warden and student, filterable by block, with an option to include full rooms.
A student can view only their own allocation.
Role-based access: only admin and warden manage allocations, rooms and students; students and accountants are refused.
Authentication: valid logins by role, invalid logins rejected, POST-only logout, safe redirects, lockout after repeated failures, stale sessions handled.
CSRF protection on every state-changing request (login, create, reallocate, cancel, logout).
Secure configuration: no hard-coded secret, debug off by default, demo data and credentials opt-in, security headers, hardened cookies, self-hosted assets.
SQL-injection and XSS input is handled safely (no SQL error, output escaped, data intact).
Role-specific dashboards show accurate statistics and shortcuts.
Admin can add hostel blocks, rooms and students through the interface (validated, CSRF-protected, admin only) so a fresh installation can be populated and used.

statement: Consistent layout and navigation (sidebar, breadcrumb, page title); menus match the user role (My Allocation only for students).
Responsive layout: no horizontal page overflow from 320px to desktop; the hamburger never overlaps the page title; the navigation drawer opens.
Feedback: success and error messages, validation errors keep the entered values, confirmation before destructive actions, empty states.
Accessibility basics: every control labelled, accessible names on landmarks and icon buttons, described progress bars, visible focus.
Exactly one logout control, implemented as a CSRF-protected POST form.
Pages contain no leaked markup or placeholders and load only self-hosted assets under a strict CSP.
